info.title: Typeform: forms and responses (reviewed subset)
info.description: The part of Typeform's API a taf reads: the account's forms, one form, and a form's responses. Written by hand from Typeform's documented Create and Responses APIs, since Typeform publishes no machine-readable description. Read-only.

personal_token.description: A Typeform personal access token with forms:read and responses:read

parameters.description: Only forms whose title contains this

get.summary: Read one form and its questions

parameters.description: Responses submitted before this time (ISO 8601, UTC)
